projects.title: Leon
projects.description: Leon is a static landing page template characterized by a modern and clean design intended for reuse in various web projects.

projects.title: Kasper
projects.description: Kasper is a sophisticated, single-page HTML, CSS, and JS template designed for corporate and creative agency websites. It features a modern dark-themed aesthetic with sections for services, portfolio showcases, and client testimonials.

projects.title: Elzero
projects.description: Elzero is a described as a feature-rich, multi-section HTML, CSS, and JS template designed to resemble a professional portfolio or agency website. Key features include a mega navigation system, dedicated sections for teams, skills, and events, as well as interactive elements like a pricing table and categorized gallery.
